'''Tumul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Wearing a [[Color/Legends|gold]] and red set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a helmet, he worked selling equipment in the supplies section of the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] positioned within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tumul was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as an Imperial operations gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
